name: factsdir
parts: lineitem: I64 [mode, kmin]: l_partkey directory mode (1: present) and smallest l_partkey
lineitem: U32 l_partkey directory offsets into the inherited l_partkey key index, nkeys + 1 entries (mode 1)
orders: I64 [mode, kmin]: o_orderkey directory mode (1: present) and smallest o_orderkey
orders: U32 o_orderkey directory: entry e is the stored orders row whose o_orderkey is kmin + e, or 0xffffffff when none

layout.summary: facts unchanged (75 inherited parts: lineitem and orders, orders by o_orderdate, lineitem co-clustered), then a dense directory over facts' l_partkey key index (I64 [mode, kmin], U32 offsets: positions offs[k - kmin] .. offs[k - kmin + 1] of the index hold exactly the stored lineitem rows of l_partkey k) and a dense o_orderkey directory of orders (I64 [mode, kmin], U32 stored orders row per key, 0xffffffff for absent keys). The interface restates facts' description of the inherited parts (base_represents) so a query reads only this storage.
layout.units: keys are bigint l_partkey / o_orderkey values; l_partkey offsets are positions (0 .. lineitem rows) in the inherited l_partkey key index; o_orderkey entries are stored orders rows (0 .. orders rows) of facts
